replacement: The old man was absolutely delighted. He wrote the note and sent for the horses. A light lunch was brought in, with brandy. When Fyodor Pavlovitch was pleased, he usually became expansive, but today he seemed to hold himself back. He did not say a word about Dmitri, for instance. The parting left him quite unmoved, and he actually seemed at a loss for something to say. Ivan noticed this particularly. “He must be tired of me,” he thought. Only when he went out with his son onto the steps did the old man start to fuss. He would have kissed him, but Ivan hurried to hold out his hand, plainly avoiding the kiss. His father saw it at once and immediately pulled himself up.
